notes.title: NextBuild Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We’re excited to share some updates about the development of NextBuild! The game is actively being developed, and we’re making great progress. We’re aiming to release a demo in Q1 or Q2, so stay tuned for more details as we get closer to that milestone.

To stay updated, be sure to follow us on our social platforms where we’re sharing sneak peeks and updates regularly. We're also preparing a Discord server for our community, where you’ll be able to connect with other players, share feedback, and get the latest news directly.

Additionally, we've uploaded new videos on TikTok showcasing some of the exciting features and gameplay elements we’ve been working on. Make sure to check them out and give us a follow for more behind-the-scenes content.

Thank you for your continued support, and we can’t wait to share more of NextBuild with you soon!

Happy Building,
The NextBuild Team
